intervals.label: upgrade decision and construction
intervals.locator: Berkaev et al., JETP 113 (2011) 213, abstract; the introduction records the spring 2000 decision to modernise VEPP-2M
intervals.note: Year precision: decision in spring 2000 to modernise VEPP-2M (introduction), construction completed 2007 (abstract).
intervals.quote: In 2007, at the Institute of Nuclear Physics (Novosibirsk), the construction of the VEPP-2000 electron–positron collider was completed.

intervals.label: commissioning and first experiments
intervals.note: First beam tests (round beams at 508 MeV) from 2007; CMD-3 installed October 2009; the first experimental season was completed in summer 2010.
intervals.quote: In October 2009, a CMD-3 (cryogenic magnetic detector) was installed at the VEPP-2000 facility, and the physics program with both the SND and CMD-3 particle detectors was started in the energy range of 1–1.9 GeV.

intervals.label: e+e- collider operation
intervals.locator: Shatunov et al., IPAC-2017 abstract (start); Solodov, Phi to Psi 2026 (still collecting data: "2025 data were collected with the reverse direction of the beams")
intervals.note: Year precision for the start. The injection chain was upgraded in 2013-2016 (IPAC-2017 abstract); CMD-3 reported on 8 June 2026 that more data (x3) are to be collected in 2024-2026.
intervals.quote: VEPP-2000 e+e− collider at BINP was commissioned and started data taking with two detectors in 2010 with old injection chain.

intervals.label: upgraded injection complex
intervals.note: Injection-chain upgrade within the operating period; the 2016/2017 run was the first reported with the new BINP injection complex (VEPP-2000 news, 12 July 2017).
intervals.quote: The injection chain was significantly upgraded in 2013-2016.

name: VEPP-2000
notes: The VEPP-2000 status page (vepp2k.inp.nsk.su/status) read zero beam currents on 23 October 2026; this is a snapshot of the control-system display, not evidence that the collider is decommissioned, and the record follows the 2026 CMD-3 statement that running continues in 2024-2026.

cms_energy.note: Centre-of-mass energy range 0.3-2.0 GeV; the maximum is recorded.

peak_luminosity.note: Achieved at 2 GeV c.m. energy; the project value is 1.0 × 10^32 cm^-2 s^-1.

summary.plain: The 24-metre electron-positron ring of the Budker Institute in Novosibirsk, Siberia, which replaced VEPP-2M. It collides round beams at up to 2 GeV and has served the CMD-3 and SND detectors since 2010; CMD-3 alone reports about one inverse femtobarn collected.
summary.technical: VEPP-2000: e⁺e⁻ collider with the round-colliding-beams concept, c.m. energy 0.3-2.0 GeV, circumference 24.4 m, luminosity 0.8×10³² cm⁻² s⁻¹ achieved at 2 GeV (project 1.0×10³²); construction completed 2007, data taking with CMD-3 and SND from 2010; new injection complex 2013-2016; data taken in 2025 with the beam direction reversed.
